newsitem.title: USA: Earthquake reported in ocean north of Guam.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake reported in ocean north of Guam.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 6.3 on the open-ended Richter scale occurred in the Pacific Ocean between Guam and Saipan, the U.S. Geological Survey's Earthquake Information Centre said on Wednesday.
The center's director Waverly Person said the quake occurred about 60 miles (100 km) below the surface of the ocean.

The tremor was felt on Guam, but Person said the centre had not heard of any reports of damage on the island. The quake was reported at 5:44 a.m. on Thursday local time in Guam (3:44 p.m. EDT (1944 GMT) on Wednesday).
